registry: E33 Second Home Visa — fact registry

confidence_semantics.JELAS: Clear — primary-source verified, may be stated as fact
confidence_semantics.BERSYARAT: Conditional — verified but with conditions/caveats that must travel with the claim
confidence_semantics.BELUM_DIATUR_PUBLIK: Not publicly regulated/confirmed — must NOT be stated as fact until resolved

facts.topic: Base E33 qualifying basis — bank deposit
facts.value: USD 130,000 deposit in the applicant's own name at a state-owned (BUMN) Indonesian bank
facts.source: live imigrasi.go.id E33 page fetch 2026-07-19; research/curated-qa-corrections-2026-07-21/visa-second-home-variants.jsonl Q2
facts.notes: Own-name requirement is explicit. Which proof format the bank must issue is pending (bank_proof_format). Whether sharia (BSI) placement counts is pending (bsi_sharia_accepted).

facts.topic: Base E33 qualifying basis — property alternative
facts.value: USD 1,000,000 qualifying property — completed strata-title (hak milik atas satuan rumah susun) only; off-plan/leasehold do NOT qualify
facts.source: live imigrasi.go.id E33 page fetch 2026-07-19; research/curated-qa-corrections-2026-07-21/visa-second-home-variants.jsonl Q2
facts.notes: BERSYARAT: the strata-title-only condition must always travel with the claim. How immigration validates the property (appraisal standard) is unknown (property_validation_standard).

facts.value: Up to 5 years first grant
facts.source: live imigrasi.go.id E33 page fetch 2026-07-19; Permenkumham 22/2023 Pasal 185 (5-or-10-year first-grant activities)
facts.notes: KG golden-route text previously said '5-10 years' — corrected 2026-07-23 in kg_enhanced_retrieval.py. 10-year figure applies to other first-grant categories, not base E33.

facts.value: Base E33 (deposit/property route) is a pure residence permit — it does NOT authorize employment; paid work needs a separate work permit/KITAS
facts.source: research/curated-qa-corrections-2026-07-21/visa-golden-investor.jsonl Q17 (round-3 correction)
facts.notes: Work appears only on government-sponsored E33A/E33C variants with dual-activity (rangkap kegiatan) reporting.

facts.value: Age 55+, USD 50,000 deposit (state-owned bank) + USD 3,000/month income; 5-year validity
facts.source: live imigrasi.go.id E33E page fetch 2026-07-19; research/curated-qa-corrections-2026-07-21/visa-second-home-variants.jsonl Q7
facts.notes: BERSYARAT: age threshold is disputed for the 55-59 band in the regulation text itself — see age_55_59_ambiguity_e33e. Financial figures are not disputed.

facts.value: Senior 1-year route; USD 3,000/month income only (no deposit). USD 1,500/month is the SUPERSEDED pre-2024 figure
facts.source: research/curated-qa-corrections-2026-07-21/visa-second-home-variants.jsonl Q8; visa-catalog-sweep.jsonl KITAP-RET row (round-1 correction: 'USD 3,000/month is current; USD 1,500 is the superseded pre-2024 figure')
facts.notes: Code fixes applied 2026-07-23: catalogue.py E33F notes, match_tree.py _STEPS_RETIREMENT, generate_visa_cards.py E33F card (all said USD 1,500). Family inclusion and sponsor requirement for E33F remain unknown (e33f_family_inclusion, e33f_sponsor_requirement).

facts.value: First grant <5 years → 6-year cumulative cap; first grant ≥5 years → 10-year cumulative cap
facts.source: Permenkumham 22/2023 Pasal 113 (primary-text pdftotext); research/visa/2026-07-21-e31j-e33f-kitap-verification.md
facts.notes: Operative cap article is Pasal 113, NOT Pasal 185 (Pasal 185 defines first-grant durations). E33F is capped: ~5 years annual renewal → Retirement KITAP, not an exception to the 6-year ceiling.

facts.value: Permenkumham 11/2024 internal inconsistency: Pasal 33(2)(j)(4) says 55, Pasal 33(10)(d) says 60
facts.source: Permenkumham 11/2024 (primary-text pdftotext), per research/curated-qa-corrections-2026-07-21/README.md round-2 adjudication; research/visa/2026-07-21-e31j-e33f-kitap-verification.md
facts.notes: 11/2024 amends Pasal 33/61/62 from 60 to '55 (lima puluh lima) tahun atau lebih' but Pasal 33(10)(d) still reads 60. Live imigrasi pages state 55 — operate on 55, disclose the ambiguity, never assert the 55-59 band is uncontested.
